judged_text: Email send failures are swallowed with a bare console.log, so the success toast and 'Guests added' return value are reported even when no notifications or .ics updates went out. The organizer and guests silently never receive the updated invitation while the UI confirms success, and operators get no error signal beyond a console line.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is wrapped in a `try/catch` that only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and then continues to return `{ message: "Guests added" }`. That means the TRPC mutation will still resolve successfully and the UI (`AddGuestsDialog` onSuccess toast `t("guests_added")`) will report success even if notification emails (and their attached ICS payloads) fail to send, with no structured error/telemetry beyond a console line. However, the finding’s claim that “.ics updates went out” is not fully supported because calendar updates are performed separately via `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` and would still fail the mutation if they throw.
